text:
incident-bot: PAGER — us-west2 GPU alloc queue >2m and autoscaler failing to attach due to QUOTA_EXCEEDED. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-quota
sam: ack — I'm oncall, pulling dashboards
sam: autoscaler logs show repeated errors:
```
ERROR: AttachInstance failed: code=403, message="Insufficient regional GPUs (NVIDIA) quota: requested 16, available 0"
```
priya: I'm infra lead, opening GCP SR now. Project: redwood-prod-usw2. Adding quota request and expedite.
jordan: Observability: customer impact — ~5% requests returning 429 / queued >6s for hosted routes in us-west2, latency spikes 3-5x. Some fallbacks not configured.
sam: plan: 1) reroute new allocs to us-central1 2) throttle non-critical traffic in us-west2 3) open SR to GCP
sam: applying routing change (canary 50% -> 100%)
```
# update-routing (example)
PATCH /v1/routing/policies/default
{"prefer_regions":["us-central1"]}
```
kai: recommend also lowering model variants in region to smaller bf16-quant variants to free GPUs for high-priority traffic.
priya: SR created: SR-12345678, case link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/12345678. Asked for regional GPU quota bump (+32) and temporary project-level bump. GCP ETA ~2-4h; requested priority review.
mira: Confirming Dedicated customers on reserved pools in us-west2 are NOT impacted — this is ephemeral autoscaler for hosted pools only.
jordan: created internal incident INC-4567, drafted customer advisory for status page. snippet:
"We are experiencing degraded inference performance in us-west2 for hosted API customers. We are rerouting traffic and working with GCP to restore capacity."
sam: mitigation executed: routing canary -> 50% -> 100%. queue length down ~40% after reroute. continuing monitor.
priya: additional mitigations: applied model-preference override for low-priority keys:
```
{ "policy": "prefer_smaller_models", "scope": "hosted-us-west2", "min_priority": "low" }
```
kai: enabling rate-limit map for anonymous keys in us-west2: 100rpm -> helps reduce backpressure.
incident-bot: RUNBOOK STEP COMPLETED: reroute-traffic -> true; open-sr -> SR-12345678
sam: I'll keep watching. If GCP doesn't respond in 90m we escalate to account team and consider cross-project provisioning.
sam: updating thread; last: queue length trending down, latency improving but still above baseline. Will post next update in 15m.
